items.Sentence: Wastewater treatment processes for both treatment trains include screening
Wastewater treatment processes for both treatment trains include... aerated grit removal
Wastewater treatment processes for both treatment trains include... primary sedimentation
secondary treatment with activated sludge aeration and secondary sedimentation
Solids processing at the J.B. Latham Wastewater Treatment Plant includes thickening (secondary sludge)
Solids processing at the J.B. Latham Wastewater Treatment Plant includes... anaerobic digestion
Solids processing at the J.B. Latham Wastewater Treatment Plant includes... centrifuge dewatering
